blocks.text: SOP: air and hydraulic brake inspection

This is the working cut for RDW-2280 on August 11, 2022. Cal Dreher asked for a written bound after the current path (Listen for leaks, send if quiet) stopped being honest. I am Jeilen Jones, Shop Helper, writing for Cal Dreher, Nina Soto, and Hank Morel. Primary host bay-02.ridgeway.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on wipe a hydraulic leak and send it, then open questions. If you are on the floor next shift, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the steps.

Chock. Build air. Soap fittings. Measure pushrod. Hydraulic leaks are a red tag, not a wipe. I am not restating a hallway yes. wipe a hydraulic leak and send it is out because July 21 wipe left a stain on the floor and a comeback at 62 miles. Nina wrote the customer. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: miles=62, bays=1, weeks=3, soap=1, push=2.1, wipe=1, stain=1, tag=1. Sibling tickets RDW-SOP-2022-018 and RDW-INC-2022-041. I will not reopen wipe a hydraulic leak and send it in a side thread because someone asked for a rate waiver. Nina Soto is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.
